summary: I confirm the reviser's no-spend. The worktree branch is at main (f7fdefd9) and the only difference from main is the uncommitted package-lock.json. The diff from main...HEAD is empty. `node scripts/cli.js eval lint eval-maintaining-obsidian-audit-runs-lint-script` reports ok. The scenario stays at Version 2 with `## Preflight skip` and `## Verdict Policy non-regression`, and its Design Notes already admit the baseline leak. Every claim the reviser cites checks out against the files: eval.js:236-239 (the treatment only has SKILL.md prepended), eval-trial.js:384-390 (the advisory), audit.md:93-109 (it restates the line under test and depends on the base directory), and the V2 baseline transcripts (call 1 is `find .`, call 2 reads audit.md, and trial-3 runs the script with the flags). Any scenario-only redesign would BLOCK on baseline ceiling at about 3 of 3, so a preflight would spend 3 sessions to confirm what the files already show. The only honest route is the engine change: announce a treatment-only `Base directory for this skill` outside the listed trial tree, with the isolation guard and advisory adjusted for that arm. That is out of scope for this scenario and needs a maintainer decision.
